subject: social_science

concepts.title: Calculating Gross Domestic Product
concepts.definition: The total monetary value of all final goods and services produced within a country's borders during a specific year.
concepts.key_idea: Only final goods are counted to avoid double-counting intermediate input values.
question_patterns: calculate the total gdp given these final goods
find the gdp if the final goods values are ...
what is the total value of final production
determine the gdp based on these sector outputs
compute the gdp from the provided final product values

solution_steps.action: sum the values of all final goods
solution_steps.explain: GDP is the aggregate of all final goods and services produced in an economy.

concepts.title: Sectoral Share in Employment
concepts.section: Primary, Secondary and Tertiary Sectors in India
concepts.definition: The percentage of the total workforce engaged in a specific economic sector.
concepts.key_idea: Comparing the workforce distribution across primary, secondary, and tertiary sectors.
question_patterns: calculate the percentage of workers in the primary sector
find the share of employment in the secondary sector
what is the employment percentage for the tertiary sector
compute the workforce share for a given sector
determine the percentage of total workers in this sector

solution_steps.action: divide sector workers by total workers
solution_steps.explain: Finding the proportion of the workforce in a specific sector.

concepts.title: Sectoral Share in GVA
concepts.section: Primary, Secondary and Tertiary Sectors in India
concepts.definition: The proportional contribution of a single sector to the total Gross Value Added of the economy.
concepts.key_idea: Measuring the economic importance of a sector by its output contribution.
question_patterns: calculate the gva share of the primary sector
find the percentage contribution of the secondary sector to gva
what is the tertiary sector's share in total gva
compute the gva percentage for this sector
determine the sectoral contribution to the total gva

solution_steps.action: divide sector gva by total gva
solution_steps.explain: Calculating the relative economic weight of a sector.

worked_examples.question_pattern: If primary sector value is {primary_val} and secondary is {secondary_val} and tertiary is {tertiary_val}, find GDP.
If {sector_workers} work in a sector out of {total_workers} total, find the employment percentage.

questions: Calculate the share of the three sectors in GDP using the provided data.
What is the percentage of people in the unorganised sector in agriculture?
If a city has 15 lakh workers and 11 lakh are in the unorganised sector, what is the percentage of unorganised workers?
